name: Fiorenzato Pietro (M-Modal burrs)
details: Vertical hand grinder with 58 mm flat burrs and a stepless ring nut numbered 0–10. These are the M-Modal burrs (multi-purpose, aimed at filter).

notes.turkish: Honest Coffee Guide lists no Turkish range for the M-Modal burrs, and Fiorenzato's chart shows none.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 0–2.0, moka pot 1.8–5.7, AeroPress 1.2–9.7, V60 2.3–6.2, filter coffee machine 1.0–8.9, French press 6.2–10.0, cold brew 7.6–10.0; Turkish N/A. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. Fiorenzato's own ring-nut chart (in the Pietro manual) shows no espresso range for these burrs, so treat the espresso row as a stretch.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
